long_description:
We amplify worker produtivity by10X. Restaurants and food retail businesses require high volume and consistency, yet many business owners struggle to achieve this. Employees also dislike working in repetitive and labor-intensive environments, where even a slight mistake can lead to customer complaints. This results in high turnover rates in the restaurant industry.

Our goal is to let robots and machines handle the boring, laborious tasks so that humans can focus on engaging with customers and collecting product feedback.

launches.title: Yummy Future - Robot workforce for the Food & Beverage industry
launches.tagline: Advance the Food & Beverage industry and tackle inflation with robots.
launches.body:
# **TL;DR**

Yummy Future creates a cutting-edge **robot workforce** designed specifically for the food and beverage industry to tackle inflation. Our technology reduces the burden on human workers, allowing them to focus on building closer connections with customers.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=86631&key=user_uploads/310507/94f263ae-be8f-49a6-b20a-3d3a8fc988b9)

## **The Problem: Restaurant Price Inflation**

According to Finance Buzz, restaurant prices increased by an average of 60% between 2014 and 2024—nearly double the national inflation rate. To make matters worse, service quality has declined. CNBC reports that 25.9% of Starbucks customers experienced longer wait times, reflecting a broader trend of labor shortages in the industry.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=86631&key=user_uploads/310507/7b2798ce-cc88-4789-98cf-124637dd96cc)

Why is the labor shortage happening?

Many workers view server or barista roles as unsustainable long-term careers, especially on minimum wage, leading to **high turnover rates**, such as **130.7%** in 2020. This forces businesses to incur additional expenses for hiring, training, and maintaining staff while overburdening existing employees to stay profitable.

# **Our solution**

We're here to change the game—making businesses profitable while ensuring workers find satisfaction and sustainability in their roles.

[YC launch Video](https://youtu.be/3cQhbJTUL10)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=86631&key=user_uploads/310507/ec24464e-a9a9-4eda-b0ce-52e69a6884d4)

Our system is a high-throughput, modular, and reconfigurable solution, designed to serve as a flexible multi-category food and beverage assembly line. By automating routine and production-heavy tasks, it reduces the burden on human workers, allowing them to focus on building closer connections with customers—answering questions, addressing their needs, and fostering meaningful interactions.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=86631&key=user_uploads/310507/10db4630-8784-4114-a96f-85cf52a555f3)

# **Our ask**

We’d love to hear from you:

* **Support Our Crowdfunding Campaign:** <https://wefunder.com/yummy>
* **Franchising Interests:** Let’s explore how we can grow together.
* **Partnership Opportunities:** If you have an existing brand and want to integrate our solution, let’s collaborate!
* **Join the Waitlist for Coffee Shop in a Box:** Email us at [business@yummy-future.com](mailto:business@yummy-future.com)

We look forward to connecting and working together!
